name: Namegata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Namegata city emblem in light blue, pink and green: curved strokes in green, light blue and pink like stylised petals.
history: Municipal flag of Namegata, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 September 2005.

features.role: Namegata city emblem — curved strokes in green, light blue and pink like stylised petals
